newsitem.title: USA: Nabors to buy land rigs from Noble.
newsitem.headline: Nabors to buy land rigs from Noble.

text.p: Nabors Industries Inc said on Friday that it signed a definitive agreement to buy 47 land drilling rigs from Noble Drilling Corp for $60 million in cash.

The fleet of rigs consists of 19 operating rigs and 28 stack rigs in various stages of completeness, the company said. Nine of the operating rigs are located in Canada and the other 10 are located throughout the Austin Chalk of East Texas. The stacked rigs are located in areas near some of its best markets, the company said.
In a separate release, Noble Drilling said its land drilling operations had become less significant in recent years as the company emphasized its international and domestic offshore operations.
